business_summary: Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of broadcast equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers broadcast cameras, including studio and portable camera systems, digital cameras, HDTV camera systems, camera control units, base station, IP extension unit, fiber camera adaptors, OLED and LCD viewfinders, system expanders, operation control panels, portable viewfinder, tripod mounting plate, relay/broadcasting system/news gathering equipment, command converters, and helicopter tv system; medical equipment, such as output and medical grade cameras, LCD color monitors, and digital video recorders; inspection equipment, including tablet inspection equipment, color visual tablet inspection equipment; color powdered/granulated medicine inspection equipment, tablet inspection machine, inkjet tablet printing system, plane and single sheet visual, inspection equipment for checking surface of films, panels, and metal foils; and security camera systems. Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Ikegami Tsushinki Seisakusho and changed its name to Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. in 1951. Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is based in Ota, Japan.
